properties.name: BF/373
properties.site-address: Former Istil Mill Site, Rushenden Road, Queenborough
properties.notes: The site forms part of the Queenborough & Rushenden Masterplan and its inclusion for a Permission in Principle could undermine this process. An application has been submitted for ground raising (18/502348/FULL) in preparation for future residential development and is pending consideration.. The site is a former steel rolling mill site and most of the associated structures have been demolished with hardstanding and vegetation remaining. Access is taken from Thomsett Way to the South.
